subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: What is the simple interest on ₹2000 at 5% per annum for 3 years?
solution: Simple Interest = (Principal * Rate * Time) / 100 = (2000 * 5 * 3) / 100 = 300. Topic (Simple and Compound Interest) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
